G435.d: a man; husband; a man, a male person
s: And they that had eaten were about five thousand «men», beside women and children.
And Jacob begat Joseph the «husband» of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
And he «opened» his mouth, and taught them, saying,
When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and «departed» into Egypt:
But when Jesus knew it, he «withdrew» himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

G473.d: instead of, in place of, for; over against; co-operation; requital; opposition; substitution
s: «Therefore» whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

G444.d: man; generically, a human being, male or female; a merchant; men, people; some one, a man; one
s: Or what «man» is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of «men».
Recompense to no «man» evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all «men».
Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of «Andrew» and Peter.

G476.d: an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary
s: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine «adversary».
And they were not able to «resist» the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly «withstood» our words.

G472.d: to hold firmly to, cleave to
s: «Holding» fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
And because «iniquity» shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
And when they were come into the ship, the «wind» ceased.

G450.d: to raise up; to raise up, cause to be born or appear; to rise; to arise, appear
s: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he «arose».
And said unto them, Why sleep ye? «rise» and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
And he left all, «rose» «up», and followed him.
But it shall be «more» «tolerable» for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
Use hospitality one to another «without» grudging.
These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with «unwashen» hands defileth not a man.

G465.d: an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce
s: Or what shall a man give in «exchange» for his soul?

G430.d: to hold up; to bear with, endure
s: For ye «suffer» fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should «bear» with you:
With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, «forbearing» one another in love;

Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and «anise» and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the «lawless» and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
And she spake «out» with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

G482.d: of persons, to help; of things, to partake of
s: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the «benefit». These things teach and exhort.

G429.d: to find out by search, discover
s: And they came with haste, and «found» Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

G483.d: cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: 2:9; with dative, with accusative and inf., T; pass.,.† (AS)
s: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising «again» of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be «spoken» «against»;
And there was one «Anna», a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

G437.d: to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to
s: And she coming in that instant «gave» thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
Now «Annas» had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
But they shall proceed no further: for their «folly» shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and «passed» by on the other side.

G461.d: to set upright or straight again, restore
s: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was «made» «straight», and glorified God.
And in nothing terrified by your «adversaries»: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
And they could not «answer» him again to these things.

Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also «bid» thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

G468.d: requital; in favourable sense; in unfavourable sense
s: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a «recompence» unto them:

G467.d: to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital; in favourable sense; in unfavourable sense
s: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be «recompensed» unto him again?
Then said he unto the disciples, It is «impossible» but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
Are ye so «foolish»? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

G424.d: to go up: (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)
s: And Jesus «went» «up» into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
Whosoever hateth his brother is a «murderer»: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a «fire» of «coals» there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

G491.d: a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian
s: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of «Antioch»:
Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always «resist» the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto «Antioch».
But when they departed from Perga, they came to «Antioch» in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

G446.d: supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province
s: Then the «deputy», when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

G447.d: to let go, leave without support; to relax, loosen; to give up, desist from
s: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one’s bands were «loosed».
Neither is «worshipped» with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

G498.d: to range on battle against; to set oneself against, resist
s: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God «resisteth» the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be «examined» by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.

G494.d: -ίδος, ἡ Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea:.† (AS)
s: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to «Antipatris».

G425.d: a loosening, relaxation; expressed or understood, relief
s: And to you who are troubled «rest» with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
Now for a «recompence» in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, «unmerciful»:
Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and «forbearance» and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

G460.d: adv. 1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with). 2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law:.† (AS)

s: But I see another law in my members, «warring» «against» the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how «unsearchable» are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the «unsearchable» riches of Christ;
Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap «coals» of fire on his head.
Salute «Andronicus» and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

G410.d: not to be called to account, unreprovable
s: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found «blameless».

G484.d: (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ (ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) 1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange. 2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).† (AS)
s: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, «helps», governments, diversities of tongues.
Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you «like» «men», be strong.
Thanks be unto God for his «unspeakable» gift.
Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is «convenient»,
And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may «open» my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and «fill» «up» that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the «reward» of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, «unholy»,

Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous «man», but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
Who gave himself a «ransom» for all, to be testified in due time.
And these things give in charge, that they may be «blameless».
O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and «oppositions» of science falsely so called:
The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft «refreshed» me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

G422.d: not to be put to shame
s: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be «ashamed», rightly dividing the word of truth.

G420.d: (fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός) patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, and see MM, VGT, see word):.† (AS)
s: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, «patient»,

G475.d: in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose
s: In meekness instructing those that «oppose» themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the «gainsaying» of Core.

G499.d: (see: τύπος), 1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse. 2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word); (a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), (b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true …
s: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the «figures» of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:
Ye have not yet «resisted» unto blood, striving against sin.

G416.d: to be driven by the wind
s: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the «wind» and tossed.
But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the «flower» of the grass he shall pass away.
For he shall have judgment «without» «mercy», that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy «unspeakable» and full of glory:

G486.d: to rail at; abuse in turn
s: Who, when he was «reviled», «reviled» not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same «excess» of riot, speaking evil of you:

I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein «Antipas» was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
